Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly claimed Wikipedia confirmed Mexico City, Mexico as Fernando Cortés’s birthplace, likely confusing his place of residence/death with birthplace. The query itself was garbled (character encoding error) and returned no results, yet the agent asserted a conclusion. Reliable sources (including Wikipedia) state he was born in San Juan, Puerto Rico.
